plugin.note: Icefiends are 100% weak to fire spells - cast Fire Strike/Bolt/Wave with a fire staff for the fastest kills. Defence is only 12 and their max hit is 2 (magical melee), so Protect from Magic and a little food are ample. They can be safespotted behind the rocks on Ice Mountain.

requirements: No Slayer level is required to receive or kill Icefiends.
A fire spell and the runes/staff to cast it are recommended to exploit the 100% fire weakness.
mechanics: Icefiends attack with magical melee for up to 2 damage at a 4-tick speed; Protect from Magic reduces this.
They have 15 Hitpoints and Defence 12, with all defensive bonuses +0.
They are 100% weak to fire spells, so fire magic is by far the fastest style.

methods.label: Fire spells
methods.summary: Cast a fire spell (Fire Strike/Bolt/Wave) to exploit the Icefiend's 100% fire weakness.
requiredOrKeyItems: A fire staff (Fire battlestaff) and the runes for a fire spell
Slayer helmet (imbued) for the magic bonus
steps: Climb to the top of Ice Mountain (north-west of Falador).
Autocast a fire spell on Icefiends for the fastest kills against their 100% fire weakness.
Pray Protect from Magic if taking damage; their max hit is only 2.

methods.label: Melee / safespot
methods.summary: Low-level accounts can melee Icefiends, optionally safespotting them behind the mountain rocks.
steps: Attack Icefiends with a melee weapon if you lack fire spells.
Use the rocks on the mountain to safespot if desired; their magical-melee attack still reaches at range in melee distance.
Complete the 15-20 assignment before returning to Turael or Spria.

body:
# Icefiend

Icefiends are a low-level Slayer task assigned by Turael and Spria, found on top of Ice Mountain and at the God Wars Dungeon entrance. They are 100% weak to fire spells, so cast Fire Strike/Bolt/Wave with a fire staff for the fastest kills. Defence is only 12 and their max hit is 2 (magical melee), so Protect from Magic and a little food are ample. They can be safespotted behind the rocks on the mountain.
